current_milestone.title: Professional MA2 Implementation
current_milestone.active_objective: Keep the normal OpenClaw -> ZEN lean design path convenient and fully bounded. The Position application evidence gate now has a fresh-read, approval-aware Action Preview and an exact post-write Cue-content binding model. No Position application is verified; Position remains unavailable to the ordinary Designer until an explicit owner-approved real probe proves the exact Group/Preset pair.

last_closed_task.result: The ordinary OpenClaw/ZEN lean path now reuses the same bounded current-Show evidence previously available only to the SHEESH smoke runner. Fresh direct Color Preset readback plus exact Sequence 901 / Group membership checks recover only observed Build 001 Color bindings; fresh Effect-line QTY readback promotes only reserved FX_DIM_CHASE_SLOW/MED/FAST objects proven native TEMPLATE. A live SHEESH request produced an 18-Cue PENDING_APPROVAL Preview on Sequence 302 / Executor 2.8 using verified Color Presets 4.101,4.102,4.108,4.109,4.110,4.112,4.113 and Effects 2500/2501/2502 with effect_application=REAL_MACHINE_CONTENT_VERIFIED. No approval was invoked and MA2 writes remained zero. Position/movement remains unavailable because Build 001 contains no Position application evidence. Regression: 808 tests PASS.

safety_boundaries.ma2_write_audit: The original SHEESH_CURRENT_SHOW_REDESIGN_001 six-role run remains preserved unchanged. This owner-review, spatial-fact-calibration and runtime-plumbing task used no provider, MA2 transport, Resolver, Builder, Stage geometry writeback, or Show write path. All spatial eligibility flags remain NO. MA2_WRITES=0.

notes: Do not spend provider calls on backend metadata, allocation collisions, retry plumbing or representation-only repair.
Do not use the LLM as the Show database; retrieve compact verified context from Knowledge/State/cache.
Song-specific cue counts and labels belong to the calling task, not the generic compiler.
Preset and Effect objects are implementation resources, not the artistic ontology.
Ordinary implementation collisions self-heal; they are not human-review events.
A ShowPlan that already passed canonical compilation is frozen for backend retry unless a referenced runtime resource actually disappears.
Unsupported artistic dimensions stay explicit; never silently substitute another meaning.
Live mode is local/event-driven first; call an LLM only for meaningful interpretation.

The ordinary OpenClaw lean path may reuse Test Show evidence only through the same exact current-Show identity, exact Group membership and fresh object readback gates as the bounded runner; runner-only trust shortcuts are forbidden.

rules: Group name does not imply capability.
Preset type does not imply Group applicability.
Effect existence/ID does not imply artistic verification.
Only Group-bound executable Preset/Effect resources may be offered to the designer.
Unknown or unsupported dimensions remain explicit and are never semantically substituted.
